reason: False positive. EncodeX does set a Content-Security-Policy, but via the <meta http-equiv> tag in src/renderer/index.html, and Electron's advisory only inspects response headers - which a file:// load has none of. Move the policy to session.webRequest.onHeadersReceived in src/main/index.ts and this entry can be deleted; tracked as a follow-up in plans/ADVERSARIAL_TEST_HARDENING_PLAN.md.
